description: This file contains PHP functions related to retrieving and displaying HDD temperature data, including XML generation, HTML rendering, and WML formatting, for a system information script.

methods.name: xml_hddtemp
methods.description: Generates XML representation of HDD temperature data.

methods.name: html_hddtemp
methods.description: Generates HTML table rows displaying HDD temperature data.

methods.name: wml_hddtemp
methods.description: Generates WML formatted data for HDD temperatures.
